# awsettings

> Your agent's permissions and config, following you to the next machine.

An agent harness keeps its permission allowlist, enabled tool servers and hooks in a local file. Work from a second machine -- a laptop, a shell session, a dev container a phone just opened -- and none of it is there. You re-approve the same action, by hand, once per surface, forever, and the copies drift apart while every one of them looks correct.

## Install

```
pip install awsettings
```

## In Claude Code

- setting: `awsettings preset apply aitherium-claude`

## Use it in 30 seconds

Point it at your agent's settings on one machine and have them show up on the next one you open.

## Composes with

- [awdk](https://aitherium.github.io/awdk/) — Build AI agent fleets — 3 lines, any backend, local or cloud.
- [awsh](https://aitherium.github.io/awsh/) — Your terminal answers you -- type a question where a command would go.
- [awnix](https://aitherium.github.io/awnix/) — A Linux you can hand to an agent — immutable base, capabilities included.
- [awiam](https://aitherium.github.io/awiam/) — Who is this caller? A directory and session store that fails honestly.
- [awm](https://aitherium.github.io/awm/) — A portable, scoped agent memory.
- [awseal](https://aitherium.github.io/awseal/) — Sign an artifact so a stranger can verify it.
- [awshare](https://aitherium.github.io/awshare/) — Publish an artifact and fetch it back verified.
- [awresume](https://aitherium.github.io/awresume/) — The coding sessions you had open, reopened after the reboot.
- [awdesk](https://aitherium.github.io/awdesk/) — Aither World Desk -- the desktop body of AitherOS Online: tray, avatars, decision cards, the Living Desktop as an overlay.

## Where it lives

- Repo: https://github.com/Aitherium/awsettings
- Docs: https://aitherium.github.io/awsettings/
- Manifest (keys + the one-line adoption story): https://aitherium.github.io/awsettings/aither-manifest.json

This repository is mirrored from the AitherOS monorepo by `.github/workflows/sync-awsettings.yml`; hand edits made here are overwritten on the next sync — change the source instead.

Everything Aitherium, in one file for agents: https://aitherium.com/llms.txt
